items.title: Ashley Keating and Allan Whitworth Interview, 1963-03-22
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Miss Snapp, put your name on that. [INTERVIEWEE] Alright, Elizabeth Snapp.

ctx.x: 22nd of March, 1963 it is, isn't it? Okay. Can you give your name, Ashley, your first? I'll get you to give yours. Yes, Ashley Keating. And yours? Alan Whitworth. Oh, good. Miss Snapp, put your name on that.
